category_title: Ninth-grade students with EBD exhibiting classroom disengagement, peer disruption, and social skill performance deficits
scenario_title: Social skill performance deficits during peer and adult interactions
minimal_context: The student is preparing to negotiate with a teacher for a modification of an assignment due date in the general education classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Marcus, you need to go negotiate with your teacher for a modification of your assignment due date.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can verbally repeat the steps to you. I know how to do it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: That is good. Go ahead and do it now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I need to watch my e-book first. I want to rehearse the desired behavior until I am confident to perform the skill.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: There is no time for that right now. Just go try.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm not doing it! I wasn't sure I could trust this, so it wouldn't be used against me later. (Pushes chair back and refuses to participate)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Marcus, you need to go negotiate with your teacher for a modification of your assignment due date.

STUDENT: I can verbally repeat the steps to you. I know how to do it.

TUTOR: That is good. Go ahead and do it now.

STUDENT: I need to watch my e-book first. I want to rehearse the desired behavior until I am confident to perform the skill.

TUTOR: There is no time for that right now. Just go try.

STUDENT: I'm not doing it! I wasn't sure I could trust this, so it wouldn't be used against me later. (Pushes chair back and refuses to participate)

task.content: Dealing with a disagreeable situation, joining and participating in a discussion, or negotiating with a teacher for modification of due date or assignment product outcome
task.learning_goal: To perform age-appropriate social skills in the general education setting

context.social_setting: Interactions with peers and adults in the general education setting
context.time_context: Prior to and during performance attempts in class

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When required to perform social skills (e.g., dealing with a disagreeable situation) in academic classroom settings
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Exhibited performance deficits in using the skills, leading to in-school and out-of-school suspensions, despite being able to verbally repeat the steps
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Lacked confidence to perform the skill without prior rehearsal

behavior_patterns.condition: When traditional social skills instruction at Tiers 1 and 2 levels was used
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Failed in their academic classroom settings and behavior increasingly became a concern for school personnel
